title: Stress and Strain I
statement: A 2 m steel hanger rod holds a 20 kN load from a roof beam. It is overstressed, and it is already too heavy, so a thicker steel rod will not do. Choose the rod's diameter and material so that its stress stays within the material's allowable stress (yield strength divided by a design factor of 2), it stretches no more than 2 mm, and it weighs no more than 2 kg. The length, load and supports are fixed.

reflectionPrompt.text: Using your tested designs, explain how the rod's diameter changed its stress and stretch, and why the choice of material decided whether a rod could pass every check within the mass limit.
